events.title: KENYA CONFIRMS THIRD EBOLA CASE

refs.t: Kenya reports third Ebola case, contact tracing continues

events.sum: In tonight's programme, Kenya confirms a third case of Ebola, a relative of a man who died earlier this month after travelling from DR Congo. Also,Cameroonian journalist Ambe Macmillan is recovering in hospital after being shot in the legs…
